Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 1 Senior Staff Specialist Production Management (f/m/div) 

Job idHRC1872590Job familyResearch & DevelopmentDuration of employmentUnbefristetArt des ArbeitsplatzeshybridEinsteigen alsBerufserfahrene*r

#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.

Build the future nobody's dreamed of yet... are you ready to rethink the impossible? As a Senior Staff Specialist in Production Management within our Research Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise to shape the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects and bringing new ideas to life.

Are you in?

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Drive cost reduction and cost avoidance activities for PS products (IGBTs, CoolMOS, SiC) to ensure a competitive long-term cost position. 

 *  Analyze and verify new product designs to ensure manufacturability and a successful transition into production. 

 *  Take ownership of yield stabilization, optimization and monitoring during ramp-up and volume production, including initiating improvement measures. 

 *  Lead yield improvement and problem-solving activities, including focus teams and 8D processes for customer rejects and manufacturing issues. 

 *  Define and drive the manufacturing strategy in alignment with Product Lines, OP leaders and the PS board, focusing on flexibility, resilience and investment optimization. 

 *  Lead technology or product transfer projects as Project Owner or Project Manager with full responsibility for scope, budget, resources and project results. 

 *  Develop and implement new methods and tools for product analysis to enable safe product launches and smooth ramp-up to high-volume production.

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Mechatronics or a comparable field, combined with solid knowledge of power transistor processes and power technology product designs.

 * At least 3-5 years of professional experience in the semiconductor or system manufacturing industry or supply chain management. 

 * In-depth understanding of frontend and backend manufacturing processes, production requirements and manufacturing strategies. 

 * Good understanding of cross-functional processes and interfaces (e.g. PRE, QM, PMG, R&D, OP, RCM, SCP, OSAT, EWM), including relevant economic factors. 

 * Experience in managing high-profile projects and leading complex, cross-functional project teams. 

 * Experience with the 8D problem-solving methodology and leading task forces or focus teams. 

 * Strong affinity for big data and statistical analysis, with very good Excel skills; SQL database programming is an advantage.

 * Excellent English language skills; German is considered an advantage.

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p. a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.
